candidate: lifecycle_state comes from ordered explicit events
evidence_state is independent and may remain diagnostic_only after confirmation
rejected and replaced versions remain queryable
candidate_set: singleton is active count equal to one
ambiguous is multiple plausible active candidates or unresolved interpretation

concepts.semantics: Automatic candidate is retained and has no confirmation, rejection, or replacement action.
An explicit actor confirmed a stable candidate version or authored domain.
An explicit actor rejected a candidate version; evidence remains retained.
A prior version was superseded by an explicit replacement relation.

concepts.classification: cross-source relation / derived set and candidate label
concepts.semantics: Automatic and authored/user records disagree and the disagreement remains unresolved.
Evidence is displayable and auditable but cannot promote a formal domain.
A consumer evaluated dependencies and cannot produce the requested downstream result.
Some required evidence is present and some is missing or incomplete.
A present record fails an applicable validity check.
The representation or operation is outside the supported evidence contract.
No authored or user assignment relation is recorded.
Multiple plausible candidates or unresolved interpretations remain without selection.
Exactly one active, non-replaced candidate remains; this never confirms it.
Recorded selection relation state; none plus null selected ID means explicit no-selection.
Display label derived from lifecycle_state=provisional and evidence_state=diagnostic_only; never serialized as an independent source-of-truth state.

contract_shapes.recommendation: Use explicit relations/events as source of truth and derive any display status. This is not a production schema decision.

event_ordering.alternative: Full timestamp plus stable event-id tie-break is an acceptable later design alternative.
event_ordering.proposal: Use a monotonic event_sequence per candidate-set lineage as the primary order.
event_ordering.status: Design proposal only; not a frozen production schema.

ui: Confirmation requires explicit candidate and provenance.
Rejection hides from active view but keeps evidence history.
Replacement/manual edit creates a new version and shows prior history.
Conflict shows both sides and disables silent promotion.

null_and_not_available.not_available: Not_available is a downstream availability result after dependency evaluation; it is not a lifecycle state.
null_and_not_available.null: Null records absence of a relation or selected ID.
rules: Explicit no-selection uses selected_candidate_id=null plus selection_state=none.
Absent selection relation is not recorded and must remain distinguishable.
Missing domain, unresolved conflict, invalid required evidence, unsupported required representation, or incomplete required evidence propagates not_available.
No empty geometry, zero, or diagnostic frame substitutes for unavailable qualified output.

precedence_and_conflict: Qualified authored/user input has precedence for downstream domain use by owner principle, while automatic candidates remain provenance.
Automatic and authored/user disagreement remains an unresolved conflict; no production resolution rule is invented here.
Unresolved conflict cannot silently yield downstream availability; a future explicit resolution event is deferred.

selection_semantics.rule: Explicit no-selection and absent selection relation are distinct and must not be conflated.
selection_semantics.selection_not_recorded: selection_relation_present=false and no selection relation object

allowed.condition: explicit actor, stable version, ordered event, no unresolved blocking conflict
new version and prior version reference retained
explicit relation; automatic candidates remain provenance
both sides retained; future resolution remains deferred
before/after geometry and version references retained

forbidden.reason: future resolution event is explicitly deferred

unresolved_owner_decisions: Whether qualified authored input can be consumed while conflict remains visible.
Formal AnalysisDomain promotion and all selector/backend/threshold decisions.
